|Nor do I, though I suspect something bad is brewing.|
|I reckon there'll always be a Sparta. Spartans never ever will be slaves!|
|They've got no respect for our traditions - they've stripped the shrine bare!|
|There's something very wrong here since the Romans have arrived.|
|I know. Athens was better much in the good old days.|
|I do like your new dress, Phoebe!|
|Hey, thanks Rhea. Isn't it great? Egyptian linen, no less!|
|That must have cost your husband a fortune!|
|Hey girl, I'm worth it...|
|Hello brother! It's been a long time since I saw you!|
|I've been too busy fretting. Any idea why the Romans have put naphtha casks outside their houses?|
|I'm not sure. Now I think about it, it does seem dangerous to leave them there where they can get knocked over.|
|I live next door to one of them. My house could go up at any time!|
|You probably shouldn't go home.|
|Good idea. How about we go to the Bacchus Inn?|
|Alright. What time does it close?|
|With the curfew in place; pretty soon.|
|If we hurry, we'll just make it!|
|Hey Praxinos! Nice to see you again. I don't see you around much these days!|
|I've got a night-job now, so I'm usually sleeping during the day.|
|Really? What does your work entail?|
|Putting posters up around the city promoting Tiberius.|
|Oh yes, I've seen some of those.|
|But some hooligan keeps defacing them, and I only get paid if they're in one piece by the end of the night!|
|Oh, I see. I better leave you to it then!|
|I've heard the Spartans have arrived in Athens and they're hiding in the Bacchus Inn.|
|Quiet, you fool! There are Romans everywhere!|
|All this rebellion makes one feel frightfully decadent!|
|If only these hands weren't so weak; I'd gladly join my brothers in battle...|
|I never thought I'd see Sparta fall. The Spartans truly were a warrior race.|
|How's the business doing, Koinos?|
|The animal shop? Not too bad, but we had a weird guy in the other week.|
|Go on, pray tell...|
|It was this Roman guy, and he was asking if we sell dragon food.|
|Dragon food? As in a big lizard with wings?|
|I thought he was joking, so I told to him to just kidnap civilians and feed them to it!|
|Oh right. Say, have you seen Cleitos recently?|
|No, I haven't. He disappeared last week and no-one's seen him since...|
|I use olive oil on it. I want to keep it as smooth as possible.|
|Ahh. It shows. Very smooth!|
|I've heard he took out a whole village of barbarians!|
|Mmmm...yes he does, doesn't he?|
|Have you heard any of those strange noises at night?|
|Yes, and those odd lights in the sky! I never go out after dark anymore.|
|I always take my husband with me.|
|I mean, what have the Romans ever done for us?|
|My son keeps running about playing 'Spartan' - I had to take his wooden sword off him.|
|Will we ever be rid of these Romans? Marching around like they own the place...|
|Anyone want to buy some gold? Chipped off the remains of the Talos! Genuine Roman gold!|
|They might have brought us the arch, running water and central heating, but still they've managed to spoil half of our 'entertainers'.|
|I know! I wouldn't touch those Athenian beauties with a long-spear now.|
|The streets aren't safe after dark anymore.|
|Damn straight - I'm almost glad that there's a curfew on.|
|We should complain to the Mayor.|
|We should, but Tiberius had him fed to the lions.|
|I heard that Romans eat babies. Do you think it's true?|
|I wouldn't be surprised. Bloody beasts!|
|I'm on my way to the shrine to pray that the gods end this occupation. Please, join me!|
|The gods? The gods are with the Romans now!|
|What do you think of Archimedes, then?|
|In my opinion he's all smoke and mirrors...|
|Polycretes! You don't look happy, my friend. What's up?|
|This Praetorian took one look at my stall, said, "It's all Greek to me", then started smashing my vases and urns!
|I heard they brought a secret weapon to deal with the Spartan.|
|A secret weapon? What a load of bull!|
|Who would've thought we'd have so many of our Greek brothers in our own jail?|
|It makes your blood boil, doesn't it? Curse those Romans!|
|I didn't sleep well last night.|
|I know what you mean - I saw something strange in the sky last week and it's been giving me nightmares ever since.|
|Plato, Aristotle...if you ask me this rational thought theory is completely overrated!|
|I'm having real trouble filling my larder - all the quality food has been looted.|
|This Roman rationing is really playing havoc with my digestive tract.|
|I don't know why they call themselves Romans anyway - that one's clearly from Sicily!|
|Why must my son see times of war? Gods! Where are you?|
|Fools! Live by the sword, die by the sword. Have they forgotten the teachings?|
|So, what was that new Sophocles play like?|
|I'd describe it as tragi-comedy - the comedy was tragic!|
